title: [Pre Order] Google Pixel 11 256GB $0 with Optus $79/Month 36-Month Plan (in-Store Only) @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] Google Pixel 11 256GB $0 with Optus $79/Month 36-Month Plan (in-Store Only) @ Harvey Norman

[HaydosK] I pay $160 a year for my mobile data…. That's 2 months 😭. How is this a deal???? Just buy kogan mobile or boost + outright from jb or somewhere else for around 2k including mobile data and you still get the free Fitbit air. That's without waiting for sales. If you don't have the money don't buy it or use afterpay or something on the outright phone. 3 years is way too long to be paying off a phone.
[HardlyNormal] These are excellent deals if your employer pays for your sim card, or if you pay more than $37/m for your plan
[hawkeye93] It’s the deal when you cancel and only pay the termination fee instead of staying for the whole 36 months 😂
[sekhon147] What's the calculation if I cancel after 120 days? Someone help I failed math
[BargainsGrabber] The discount of the phone is essentially the etc cost and 4 months
Not worth it imo
[scottb721] How's that a neg ??? Happy to be schooled on OB protocol. Thanks
[Masticccc] I think Hardly Normal realizes how Ozbargainers abuse the 79$ for 36 months plan for Z Fold 8 series and correct it. The similar deal for Pixel 11 Fold only have 1500$ discount instead of a 0$ phone upfront, which makes it a bad deal in total.
[sekhon147] I should have bought the fold 8, held on for pixel 11 and missed it entirely
[StarV] Last day of the fold 8 plan is today I think
[HardlyNormal] It’s not HN’s fault for the bad deals, its Google
Optus is also funding the majority of this, we had the same poop deals last year as well because google want to inflate the price of the phone
[OZBsince2018] For Pixel 11 Pro XL 256GB, below will be the total cost:
Cancellation Fee + 4 Months Plan Fee + RRP - Gift Card
1,264 + 79x4 + 2,099 - 1,650 = 2,029
Definitely not worth.
Better for for pre-order directly with Optus and get $1,000 off the phone price with a 12 months plan, with shopback cash back and get the freebies as well. Comes out cheaper i.e. $1,656 for Pixel 11 Pro XL 512GB plus $170 cash back.
[BargainsGrabber] Well done student, Mr BG is proud of you taking over ;)
If you’re a current Optus customer, the 12 month sim gets discounted to $30/months for 12 months
[sekhon147] Whats the freebies? Can't see anything on Optus website.
[mattman] Last year they ran a bumper weekend where it was reduced to 24mth contract only ($69pm at the time).
At $79pm 24mth it's $1555 outright if you cancel after 4 months.
If it happens again
[dasher86] Do you need a current account with Optus?
I'm seeing $2255
[Jack D Price] Believe it or not, but you don't need a new phone
[mattman] HODL
$79, base non-pro, 36 months. This is not a deal.
Last year they had a 3-4 day period right before launch where it was reduced to 24 month.
[Pacify] Hopefully there's a deal as good as last year, I really should have done the jbhifi one while it was pretty good
[bleeder] Wouldn't they have announced theirs by now?
[itsmoe] This isn't even worth posting for the basic pixel with hardware from 2021. Ewww.
[yummypinacolada] Google Pixel is not even trying anymore, they are way behind other competitors. Pixel 1 and Pixel 2 was the peak of Google Pixel, after that they literally stopped innovating.
Now at this price, Pixel 11 series is laughable compare to other brand like Samsung, Oppo, Honor, Motorola, and Xiaomi.
